column3: The ambition to form a coherent deep-technology community is real, but the page currently shows convening more clearly than demanding mutual formation or sustained costly institution-building; maximum faith supports B, not projection into A.

A live product and named founders establish real execution, but the page cannot corroborate adoption, differentiation, or a sustained builder pattern; impact F does not force a low builder tier, yet the visible record supports capable early work rather than B-level signal.

Automating fragmented event discovery into open statewide infrastructure shows taste, agency, and maintenance on a neglected problem, but the page does not yet show the costly commitment or formative institution required for A.

Residential trade and conservation training is demanding whole-person formation, but the page reveals the federal institutional model rather than unusually strong local stewards; do not infer A-level character from program design alone.
